cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I'll carry your book bag to the platform. My shoulder should manage one more staircase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me take it. There are dictionaries in there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. No, keep your hands free for the tickets. I'll change shoulders at the bottom.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've moved our train to platform twelve, across the bridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, lead the way. I'll give each shoulder a staircase and rest my fingers while you find our seats.

mechanism: A uses a pupil travel lesson to insist on graciously carrying the load while narrating each growing bodily inconvenience.
confusable: It remains accommodating rather than demanding an apology or dropping the helpful role.
comparison: Meal sacrifice under social hosting versus bodily strain under a changed platform route.
seedUse: Keep D45 book bag/dictionaries/shoulders/bridge; S05 grade helpful offers and route finding as progress while making A continued work visible.
